messages:
Olivia (AE): LumaCare POC ready to convert. Legal sent back DPA with three asks; procurement wants PO routing and signer names. Need quick alignment so we can send final OF + DPA.

Sam (SE): Security: they want SAML SSO + SOC2. BYOK/HSM not required for POC; note BYOK available for Private per SOW.

Ruth (Legal): DPA asks: (1) 30-day data export, (2) subprocessor notice+objection, (3) liability cap = 1x fees. We can accept (1) and (2) with stronger security attestations; 1x cap needs legal lead (emma_r) approval. Preparing a targeted counter.

Hector (Procurement): For PO we need full billing entity, tax ID, remit address, PO number, and two authorized signers. They use Coupa; ask for supplier ID. Prefer DocuSign with customer signing first.

Olivia (AE): I'll collect signers. Draft billing block: Customer: LumaCare Systems, Inc.; Billing: ap@lumacare.com; Remit: 77 Health Plaza, Seattle, WA; Term: 12mo; Commit: $50k/mo; Billing terms: Net30; One-time onboarding credit: $5k.

Nina (Finance): Net30 OK. Please cc finance-billing@redwood.com. If Coupa invoicing used, request their supplier ID and invoice schema now. If PO delayed, include "PO to follow" language so we can invoice.

Ruth (Legal): Add e-sign clause: "Electronic signatures (DocuSign or equivalent) have same effect as originals." If customer insists on 1x cap, I'll escalate to emma_r.

Sam (SE): Suggest OF note: "BYOK available for Private deployments via separate SOW; not in scope for POC." Keeps scope clear.

ops-privacy-bot: SOC2 report attached: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-lumacare

Olivia (AE): Plan: update OF with billing + credit + BYOK note, attach redlined DPA, send to LumaCare legal and request Coupa supplier ID + signer names. I'll cc Ruth, Nina, and ops-privacy. Posting replies here. :thumbsup:
